name: Attachment Tray
description: A horizontally scrolling row of attached files above the prompt: image thumbnails and document tiles that drop in one by one and close up when removed.

props.name: files
props.type: { id: string; name: string; type?: string; src?: string }[]
props.description: The files in order. type is a MIME type; with the name's extension it picks the icon and tint. Images with a src show as square thumbnails.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Called when a tile's remove button is pressed. Without it the tiles have no remove button.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Other div props are spread onto it.

props.name: file
props.type: { id: string; name: string; type?: string; src?: string }
props.description: The file to show. Long names are cut in the middle so the extension stays visible.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Shows a small remove button on the tile's corner.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the tile. Other div props are spread onto it.
